name: Terrain texture
description: Quiet opaque basin surfaces, kept low contrast for readable actors and props.

name: Ground tile
description: Walkable material tiles used as local surface variation.

name: Terrain transition
description: Transparent seams and ramps connecting basin ground to leyline fractures.

name: Fault flora
description: Sparse plants adapted to mineral cracks; never a forest canopy.

name: Stone and ore
description: Blockers and harvest nodes formed by the exposed meridian.

name: Water feature
description: Small uphill flows and contained pools; no broad lake or wetland.

name: Survey and warding props
description: Compact bronze and stone instruments used to measure or stabilize the fault.

name: Travel and wayfinding
description: Grounded routes that cross narrow fissures and link safe survey points.

name: Landmarks and environment detail
description: Distinctive basin-scale silhouettes that reinforce the celadon fault identity.
